title: EzAnvil
body:
Are you tired of constantly grinding iron? Do you wish you didn’t have to grind so much iron just to craft a single Anvil?

With this mod, you won’t need to collect as much iron anymore. It reduces the crafting cost of anvils from 3 iron blocks and 4 ingots to just 1 iron block and 6 ingots.
![1 iron block in the middle 6 iron ingots on top and bottom rows = anvil](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/557d3692e411935374042bef7b8b26760eac5f73.png)

I made a discord server you can join if you want [https://discord.gg/UbPywERWPC](https://discord.gg/UbPywERWPC)
